create_bit_model: create a BiT image feature extractor model from a BitConfig for backbone or classification
build_image_classifier: build a BiT model with image classification head for ImageNet-style label prediction
build_backbone: build a BiT backbone model to extract multi-scale feature maps for DETR and MaskFormer

review_bit_embeddings: review the BiT embedding stem with weight-standardized convolution and pooling
